requires.note: Generate with prepare_stargus_terrain.py from the converted graphics tree
Generate with prepare_stargus_menu.py from the converted game tree
Converted menu soundtrack companions, if available

instructions:
Use Startool with your StarCraft/Brood War installation on the computer, then copy the complete converted tree to /sd/roms/stargus.

Run pax-recipe/tools/prepare_stargus_terrain.py GRAPHICS OUTPUT to create media/terrain.paxtile, and prepare_stargus_menu.py GAME_ROOT OUTPUT to create media/menu.paxmenu. Use --help for their input options. Keep generated soundtrack companions in media. The compact runtime graphics and sound catalog are build inputs embedded in stargus.pax; rebuilding uses build_stratagus_pax.sh. Raw MPQ files alone are not the prepared PAX runtime data.

/sd/roms/stargus/scripts/stratagus.lua — Startool-converted game scripts

/sd/roms/stargus/graphics — Converted palette/graphics tree

/sd/roms/stargus/sounds — Converted sound tree

/sd/roms/stargus/media/terrain.paxtile — Generate with prepare_stargus_terrain.py from the converted graphics tree

/sd/roms/stargus/media/menu.paxmenu — Generate with prepare_stargus_menu.py from the converted game tree

/sd/roms/stargus/media/*.ogg — Converted menu soundtrack companions, if available
